title: KeyBootstrapRequest
description: POST /aab/v1/key-bootstrap-ceremonies: a registry's first key (AAB-PLATFORM-09 section 3a). Three statements, each signed with the key being registered; for a country, the Platform Owner's co-signature and the attested evidence for their key.

publicKey.description: An Ed25519 public key, SPKI DER, standard base64.

possessionSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.

registrationSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.

holderSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.

cosignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the statement's canonical JSON: 64 bytes, standard base64, made outside the server.
